newsitem.title: USA: Brush Wellman sees Q4 EPS $0.35-$0.40.
newsitem.headline: Brush Wellman sees Q4 EPS $0.35-$0.40.

text.p: Brush Wellman Inc said on Wednesday it expected its fourth quarter earnings to be between $0.35 and $0.40 per share and its fiscal 1996 earnings to be between $1.45 and $1.50 per share.
The company said it expected 1997 sales and earnings to be similar to 1996 levels. Chairman Gordon Harnett said 1996 sales would probably establish an all-time record for the third year in a row.
The First Call consensus earnings estimate for the fourth quarter was $0.30 per share and and the fiscal 1996 estimate was $1.41 per share.
Brush Wellman earned $0.24 per share in the fourth quarter of 1995 and $1.26 per share for the full year.

"We are committed to a major program of investment to upgrade and expand our capabilities," Harnett said. "These investments are targeted toward positioning Brush Wellman for significant growth in sales and earnings in 1998 and beyond."
